# PuffPAI BuildBot

> BuildBot is a goal-agnostic factory that builds a local personal AI bot from one plain-words goal, on the owner's own computer, with a local model as the brain. One pipeline interprets the goal into jobs, finds what people already made, classifies each find by how it runs (APP, TOOL, DATA, TEXT, GUIDE), picks one route per job (app as built, connected tool, app put together from data, or nothing found yet), shows one setup list, asks one Yes, then makes and proves each job. Three zones: the vault, the brain, and the Bridge (the only way out, every outside service behind its own switch: the named outside services ship off, and BuildBot's own finders, searching GitHub for apps, downloading the app you picked, the free book library and catalog refresh, are on from the start so the wizard can look for apps and books, each with a switch on "What leaves your computer").

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what BuildBot is, the three zones, the agent team, the build steps and decision table, consent, data files, how to extend, how to test, hard rules
- [AGENTS.md#add-another-cloud-model-for-toolsmith](AGENTS.md#add-another-cloud-model-for-toolsmith): how to add another cloud model for Toolsmith (OpenAI, Google Gemini or any other provider), every file to touch in order, with the hard rules
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): module map, data flow, build.json schema, Bridge and consent flow, run_here containment, Toolsmith loop, assembled app contract, chat tool loop, routes, tests
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): trust boundaries, standing security contracts, known risks
- [README.md](README.md): what owners see, install, commands
- [docs/FAQ.md](docs/FAQ.md): short answers by audience and task (getting started, adding apps, skills, tools, data, your own code folders, programs and GitHub projects, Office files, the first apps, phones, smart home, networks and firewalls, privacy and the three zones, what Toolsmith may touch, models including Toolsmith's optional cloud model, developers, troubleshooting), each true to the code today, with what is not built yet said plainly
- [docs/FAQ.md#working-on-the-developer-page](docs/FAQ.md#working-on-the-developer-page): the Developer page card by card, a workflow for it, what needs a Yes, a PIN or a restart, what is not built, running from source, the checks to run, where its code is and how to add a card or route
- [docs/ISSUES.md](docs/ISSUES.md): how to report a bug or ask for a feature on the issue tracker (https://github.com/CypherSisters/PuffPAIBuildBot/issues), what logs to attach, how to take private things out; templates in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#11-diagrams](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#11-diagrams): Mermaid diagrams of the three zones, the seven agents, the build as four questions, how a found app runs and how the brain reaches it, and the Yes and the Bridge

## Key modules

- [src/puffpai/build/pipeline.py](src/puffpai/build/pipeline.py): the one build pipeline
- [src/puffpai/build/schema.py](src/puffpai/build/schema.py): enums, the Job record, build.json
- [src/puffpai/build/classify.py](src/puffpai/build/classify.py): classes by how a thing runs
- [src/puffpai/build/decide.py](src/puffpai/build/decide.py): fits and routes
- [src/puffpai/build/make.py](src/puffpai/build/make.py): making each route after the Yes
- [src/puffpai/build/prove.py](src/puffpai/build/prove.py): working means it answered a real ask
- [src/puffpai/integrate/run_here.py](src/puffpai/integrate/run_here.py): outside projects on this computer, loopback only
- [src/puffpai/assemble/toolsmith_loop.py](src/puffpai/assemble/toolsmith_loop.py): write, run, fix connecting code
- [src/puffpai/security/egress_doors.py](src/puffpai/security/egress_doors.py): the Bridge
- [src/puffpai/security/consent_tickets.py](src/puffpai/security/consent_tickets.py): single-use consent tickets
- [src/puffpai/drawbridge.py](src/puffpai/drawbridge.py): checks on every addition
- [src/puffpai/brain_loop.py](src/puffpai/brain_loop.py): the chat tool loop
- [src/puffpai/brain_tools.py](src/puffpai/brain_tools.py): the one tool registry
